title: Write release notes tied to stories
statement: As a product manager, I can write public and private release notes, each linked to the stories it describes, so every claim about a release traces back to the intent behind it.
overview: This is the same rule as a Task's: if there is no story to point at, write the story first. See the open question in the feature overview about fixes that have no obvious story.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Each note is either public or private, and adding a note without saying which is refused.
Adding a note that links no story, or changing a note so it links none, is refused, and the refusal says to write or find the story first.
A note may only link stories the release delivers or affects; naming another is refused with the command that adds it.
A release's page shows its public and private notes separately, each with links to its stories.
